test_title: PYST 47: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - GA (Held On: 24 Jun, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In April 2025, India and Italy strengthened their strategic partnership by advancing cooperation in which of the following areas?

options.text: Trade, defense, clean energy, and connectivity

solution:
The correct answer is __**Trade, defense, clean energy, and connectivity**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• In April 2025, India and Italy advanced their strategic partnership, focusing on **trade, defense, clean energy, and connectivity**.
 
• The collaboration emphasizes strengthening **bilateral trade**, with both nations aiming to boost economic exchanges and enhance market access.
 
• Defense cooperation includes joint military exercises, technology sharing, and defense manufacturing under India’s **‘Make in India’ initiative**.
 
• Clean energy collaboration focuses on renewable energy, particularly in the areas of **solar, wind, and hydrogen energy**, to combat climate change.
 
• Connectivity initiatives highlight projects like **transport infrastructure, smart cities, and digital innovation** to improve economic integration between the two countries.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **India-Italy Bilateral Relations:**

 
 
• India and Italy enjoy a robust relationship based on shared democratic values, cultural ties, and economic interests.
 
• Italy is one of India’s largest trading partners in the European Union, with bilateral trade crossing significant milestones in recent years.
 
 
 
• **Defense Cooperation:**
 
 
• The partnership includes joint military exercises, defense R&D, and technology-sharing agreements.
 
• Italy has expressed interest in collaborating on India’s defense manufacturing programs, aligning with the ‘Make in India’ initiative.
 
 
 
• **Clean Energy Initiatives:**
 
 
• India and Italy are committed to achieving sustainable development through renewable energy projects.
 
• Both nations are part of international frameworks like the International Solar Alliance (ISA) to promote clean energy adoption.
 
 
 
• **Connectivity and Digital Innovation:**
 
 
• Connectivity efforts include enhancing infrastructure in sectors like transport and smart cities.
 
• Digital innovation focuses on AI, IoT, and blockchain technologies to boost economic and technological integration.
